description: This Java class configures the TestRail API client within a Spring application. It sets up authentication, HTTP client interceptors, and Retrofit for API communication, ensuring proper URL formatting and credentials handling for TestRail integration.

classes.name: TestRailConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up the TestRail API client with necessary credentials, URL handling, and HTTP interceptors.

classes.name: TestRailIndexPhpInterceptor
classes.description: Custom OkHttp interceptor to modify API request URLs, replacing 'api/v2' with 'index.php?/api/v2' to match TestRail's URL pattern.

methods.name: testRailApiClient
methods.description: Creates and configures a Retrofit-based API client for TestRail, including authentication and URL handling.
